entries.01918bf62e72fa14: The company plans socks and pantyhose and tights and sells them under the store brands “Kutsushita-ya,” “Tabio,” “TabioMEN” and “Kutsushita-ya UPDATE.” It also plans and develops the functional sports sock brand “TABIO SPORTS.”
entries.0465661591068682: Revenue from in-store sales of socks and other items
entries.0569263cba21efd7: Revenue from wholesale sales of sports socks
entries.10284e93270a1f50: Revenue consists of proceeds from sales of socks and pantyhose and tights. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥16,812 million, down 0.2% year on year.
entries.1abd4a059a9ec9e3: Tabio Corporation has four consolidated subsidiaries and one non-consolidated subsidiary, and its consolidated number of employees as of February 28, 2026 was 268. The head office is in Naniwa-ku, Osaka, and storage and shipment of products, as well as research and testing, are handled by a base in Kōryō Town, Kitakatsuragi District, Nara Prefecture.
entries.26e85d8508043743: A business that sells socks on its own EC site and major EC malls. It is working to improve the brand experience online and to make this a new pillar of revenue. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,076 million.
entries.37284b4586360b8e: A business that plans and develops the functional sports socks brand "TABIO SPORTS" and sells it wholesale to sports specialty stores and others nationwide. Feedback from advisory contracts with professional baseball players is reflected in product development. Revenue in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥853 million.

entries.3f08d44f0b1ce36b: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥569 million.
entries.45f6922fb26f7c4e: A single segment that plans and sells socks, pantyhose and tights.
entries.4be74e685b9075c7: Tabio Corporation operates in a single segment covering socks, and it is described as the only company specializing solely in socks. It entered into a capital and business alliance with the same-industry company Naigai Co., Ltd. in 2023, and the two companies mutually hold each other’s shares.
entries.58d35ab885fbe020: Based on the segment-by-segment net sales and percentage changes printed in the analysis of operating results.
entries.5f93863f4e763744: A core business that operates domestic sock specialty stores.
entries.6d8384aa832edcb3: A socks specialist that plans socks, pantyhose and tights and sells them through specialty stores such as "Kutsushita-ya", EC, overseas stores and sports wholesale.
entries.73ad0a4ff5b12432: A business that sells high-quality socks, centered on "Made in Japan" products, at physical stores and on EC sites in the European, Asian and North American markets. Subsidiaries in France and China handle local store operations. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥1,390 million.
entries.75706a95a73f8ab0: A consolidated subsidiary operates the distribution center and inspection and research building in Kōryō Town, Nara Prefecture, and in addition to storage and shipment of products, its own group handles research, inspection and quality control. The foundation is a network of 266 specialty stores combining directly operated stores and franchises, and a strategy of differentiated use of multiple store brands.
entries.969eec57302d05ef: A core business that operates domestic sock specialty stores. It operates nationwide through directly operated stores and franchise chain stores under the store brands "Kutsushitaya", "Tabio", "TabioMEN" and "Kutsushitaya UPDATE". Revenue in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥12,492 million.
entries.ab1ec7cb9484e417: A business that plans and develops the functional sports socks brand "TABIO SPORTS" and sells it wholesale to sports specialty stores and others nationwide.
entries.ad75c5f9be8943db: It is a business that designs socks, pantyhose and tights, stores and inspects them at its base in Nara, and sells them through domestic specialty stores and EC, overseas stores and wholesale to sports specialty stores, earning revenue from these sales.
entries.c1f5899c7a53947d: This business sells high-quality socks centered on "Made in Japan" through physical stores and EC sites in the European, Asian, and North American markets.
entries.cd3084c9e047de03: A single segment that plans and sells socks, pantyhose and tights. It consists of the company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries (Tabio Nara Co., Ltd., Tabio France S.A.S., Tabio Retail S.A.S. and Tabiou Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.) and 1 non-consolidated subsidiary (Tabio Factory Co., Ltd.). Tabio Nara Co., Ltd. handles logistics from product storage through shipment, as well as product research, inspection and quality control. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 266 in total, consisting of 154 directly operated stores and 112 franchise chain stores. Revenue in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥16,812 million.
